The '''Kli'aari''' were a four-[[Limb/Legends|armed]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to [[Kli'aar]]. They were known for their gentleness and their mechanical skills. Enclaves of Kli'aari could be found on most inhabited worlds located in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]].
